description: SmartCustomer for ChatGPT makes it easy to check the ratings and reviews of a business before making a purchase. Just ask about the trustworthiness or reputation of a business and SmartCustomer will provide the average rating, a summary of customer feedback, and additional trust signals to help you make better purchasing decisions. Conduct your research directly in chat so you can shop with confidence.
